steps.description: The README's headline findings. commit.author: abhyudayb-1
commit.title: Add Phase 7 (steps 45-52): website feature parity plan

steps.description: Strategy settings explorer. **Target vol and leverage cap in the browser:** export daily unlevered returns, the daily risk-free rate and each rebalance's `trailing_vol` (measured 53 KB gzipped at 10 significant figures, lazy); JS computes `L = clip(t/σ̂, [lo, hi])` per rebalance, applies it **strictly before** each return date (the one-day rule), then `L·r_a − (L−1)·r_f` and the metrics, on every slider input. **Start date by slicing, not re-running:** measured at starts in 2010, 2015 and 2019, a later start changes the weights only in its first year (at most 1.2 pp), they converge to ~1e-5 within two years, and CAGR over the overlap matches the full-history run to four decimals. So the explorer cuts the full-history run to the chosen date range in the browser and says so — the same "run the whole history, cut afterwards" rule step 44 uses — with no per-start files. **Slider bounds mirror the engine's own validation:** target vol > 0, leverage floor > 0 (`overlay` raises on a floor of 0: "the overlay may hold no position at all, which is a different strategy"), floor ≤ ceiling. The explorer's result is always shown *beside* the published one, never in place of it. Also have the export write a fixture of Python `run_backtest(target_vol=…, leverage_cap=…)` at 2–3 non-default settings, for step 50.
steps.done: Every slider update completes in under 16 ms (the reference implementation takes 0.1 ms); a setting the engine would reject cannot be entered; the published numbers never change when the explorer moves
